​Join us for an afternoon of pickleball and fellowship!

​The Rotary Club of Atlanta Metro is proud to host our inaugural pickleball tournament, Pickleball for Polio, with all proceeds benefiting Rotary International’s End Polio Now campaign.

​Since the campaign began, Rotary has helped reduce global polio cases by 99.9%. Today, wild polio remains endemic in only two countries, meaning our efforts matter more than ever.

​What to expect:

​• Come with a partner or sign up solo. We’ll match you with someone!

​•Bring your own paddle.

​•Light refreshments will be served.

​•Open to community members and Rotary club members alike.

​• Winning team receives a $200 cash prize!

​See you on the courts!
Location: Sandy Springs Racquet Center, 500 Abernathy Rd NE, Atlanta, GA 30328, USA
